selection: All64 UNRESOLVED_SPECTRAL_FEATURE rows, unchanged; no tuning of detector, rejection or origin disposition.
rv: Use exact exposure ancillary CCF_A header ESO DRS CCF RVC when finite, with provenance and mask. Do not replace missing RVC by target planning velocity. Approximate stellar-air wavelength=lambda_bary_air/(1+RVC/c), c299792.458km/s; no precision rest-frame identification or air-vacuum conversion.

bands.label: CH G band index passband context

band_interpretation: Broad published stellar absorption passbands only, not an identification of individual peaks as CN/CH lines. Frame/air convention of broad bandpass definitions is approximate and not used for narrow line matching.
profile: From same exposure barycentric-air 1D spectrum: save ±10Å; candidate core median within ±0.025Å, descriptive peak max of3-pointmedian within±0.06Å. Upper-envelope percentiles90/95 for offsets1–5Å and3–10Å, excluding nonfinite/error<=0 values; central-to-envelope ratios descriptive, not calibrated continuum/excess or significance. No threshold yields a classification.
groups: Within each target deterministic sorted maximum span0.06Å in approximate stellar-air centers, then compare group medians across targets with fixed0.10Å maximum-span bins. Keep exact offsets and RV spread; grouping not chemical identification.
output: Every64event recorded with input hashes, RV provenance, approximate frame, broad band context, context ratios, figures and limitations. All original classifications unchanged.
